scope: Enforce documented DXF domains for HATCH/MPOLYGON pattern selectors: group 75 and 76 in 0..2, group 77 in 0/1. Apply the same limits to typed HATCH output admission.

implementationReadiness.sourceObservation: DRW_Hatch::parseCode retained arbitrary values for group 75 (hatch style), group 76 (pattern type), and group 77 (double-pattern flag). The HATCH writer admitted group-75/group-76 values throughout the uint16 range even though Autodesk documents only 0..2; it already bounded group 77 to 0/1.

normativeEvidence.source: Autodesk AutoCAD 2024 DXF Reference, HATCH group codes
normativeEvidence.relevantRule: Group 75 hatch style is 0, 1, or 2; group 76 pattern type is 0, 1, or 2; group 77 double-pattern flag is 0 or 1. The table applies to HATCH and MPOLYGON entities.

implementationReadiness.change: The base HATCH parser rejects out-of-domain selector values before assignment. The typed HATCH writer now restricts style and pattern type to 0..2, in addition to its existing group-77 0/1 guard.

coverage: The parser accepts groups 75 and 76 at values 0, 1, and 2, and group 77 at values 0 and 1 in both encodings.
The parser rejects -1 and the first value above each field domain without changing the prior typed value.
Typed ASCII and Binary HATCH writers refuse group-75 value 3, group-76 value 3, and group-77 value 2 before emitting a record.

limitations: Generated field-domain controls only; no physical producer or native fill/rendering behavior was exercised.
No support claim is promoted; broader HATCH/MPOLYGON topology and native behavior remain open.
nextReadyPacket: Continue with another independently actionable P6 local gap; keep physical producer and native HATCH semantics separate from generated field-domain evidence.
